notes.beta: This feature is Beta. Host changes need root and YSK_EXECUTE=1.
notes.noKeys: YSK Server never generates or stores staking keys.
notes.dockerSoon: Install, start, and stop ship in the next increment. This page lists instances and disk only.
notes.dryCreate: Wrote instance spec and compose (dry-run). Pass --execute and YSK_EXECUTE=1 to start containers.
notes.dryStart: Start is dry-run. Pass --execute and YSK_EXECUTE=1.

notes.dryClear: Clear is dry-run. Pass --execute and YSK_EXECUTE=1.
notes.dryMithril: Mithril restore is dry-run. Pass --execute and YSK_EXECUTE=1.
notes.dryPrune: Prune is dry-run. Pass --execute and YSK_EXECUTE=1.
notes.pruneProfile: Client-native prune is the pruned/minimal profile. Recreate to change it.
notes.switched: Network switched and chain data cleared

notes.snapshotEthCl: Reset CL data for official checkpoint sync
notes.snapshotNear: Wiped NEAR data; compose will re-init official genesis and epoch sync

wizard.title: Create node
wizard.mainnetWarn: Mainnet needs a lot of free disk (ETH often 800 GiB+). Testnet is recommended.
wizard.mainnetAck: I understand the disk and slashing risk. Continue with mainnet.
wizard.heavyWarn: This chain is heavy (large disk and high IOPS). Mainnet Solana typically needs 2 TiB+.

snapshot.mithril: Cardano uses Mithril for certified snapshot restore.
snapshot.eth: Ethereum mainnet uses official checkpoint sync on the consensus client. EL continues snap sync.
snapshot.ethEl: Hoodi/Sepolia can restore an ethPandaOps EL archive, then checkpoint-sync the CL.
snapshot.avax: Avalanche uses state-sync in the compose profile.
snapshot.near: Official free NEAR tarball snapshots were retired. Restore wipes data and uses official genesis plus epoch sync.
snapshot.none: No snapshot source is configured for this chain.
